name: atec web-map-service
author: docjojo

sections.description:
This plugin integrates a NO cookies, NO logging, NO Tracking web map into a designated page.

Third-Party Services

Integrity check

Once, when activating the plugin, an integrity check is requested from our server – if you give your permission.
Source: https://atecplugins.com/
Privacy policy: https://atecplugins.com/privacy-policy/

To configure and show the map on your site, this plugin requests a map data from https://atecmap.com/.
Privacy policy: https://atecmap.com/docs_en.php

Notes

If you want to place a marker on your map, please visit https://atecmap.com/docs_en.php and get an APIkey.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WP admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Select “atec Web Map Service” link in admin menu bar.
  4. Set your location.
  5. Choose a designated page and embed a shortcode.
  6. Type the placeholder [atec_wms_shortcode] to include the map.
